performance.verdict: Money not working yet — 9 milestones overdue, zero leads on $106 spent.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $106.10 spent across 28 days, 211 Meta clicks recorded, 0 leads captured in any channel — CPL is undefined and uncollectable.
5 milestones due 2026-07-31 are overdue: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account & CAPI, and landing pages & tracking — all undelivered as of today.
4 additional milestones due 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 also overdue: search campaigns, Meta reactivation lanes, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — Phase 1 is 10+ weeks behind.
Spend activated only 2026-09-03; 3-day signal (Sep 8–10: $10.53, $19.38, $16.56) shows rising spend with 0 leads — fatigue cannot explain zero results with no tracking live.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for Sep 7–10 (4 consecutive zero days) after averaging 4.1 actions/day Aug 14–Sep 6 — organic intent signal has gone dark coinciding with ad launch.

suggestions.text: Halt all Meta spend increases until landing pages, tracking, and CAPI are confirmed live — currently burning ~$13.82/day with 0 lead capture.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has spent $106.10 over 28 days and generated 0 leads because landing pages and CAPI are not live — both were due 2026-07-31 per SOW. No further daily budget increases should be approved until Nacer confirms end-to-end stack test passes (touch → GHL → reporting). Success is defined as at least 1 tracked lead appearing in GHL within 48 hours of the fix going live. Re-check by 2026-09-14.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 4 consecutive days (Sep 7–10) after 4.1/day average — confirm profile not suppressed before attributing to campaign.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for four straight days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 4.1 actions/day over the prior 24 days. Check the MedStation Weston profile for suppression, suspension, or a category policy flag. Success check: actions return above 2/day for 3 consecutive days. Re-check by 2026-09-14.

suggestions.text: Escalate 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; Phase 1 proof-of-concept cannot be evaluated without a functioning stack.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones across Ops, CRM, Meta, Google Search, and Web are overdue — the earliest by 42 days (due 2026-07-31). Without these, the $3,500–$5,000/mo retainer has no deliverable foundation and Phase 1 cannot be benchmarked on booked appointments. Sohib should surface this to Mateus and his father with a revised delivery date for each item. Confirm all milestone owners have acknowledged updated deadlines by 2026-09-18.
